newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel wavers, looks to 129.90 support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel wavers, looks to 129.90 support.

text.p: September notionnnel futures traded on MATIF may have reached their upside limit and will start to head lower on Friday, technical analysts said.

"Notionnel is giving quite mixed signals at the moment," said Martin Scott, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London. "The most significant thing was that yesterday we broke eight-day trendline support at 130.68."
He said the contract had not regained the trendline and he expected it to form a lower high on Friday before an eventual break lower.
At 0804 GMT, September notionnel was up 0.14 at 130.58.
"The place to top out would be the 130.66, 70 region, just below resistance at 130.72. From there we could see a pull back," he said.
But any move to the downside would be muted until after the U.S. producer price data at 1230 GMT, or the beginning of next week, Scott said.
To the upside, he said if the contract did get back above 130.72 it would start to look at the recent peaks again.
But some analysts saw a short-term test to the upside for notionnel. Technical anlaysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London said the market could test up to 130.64.

"If further strength is found in the short-term, and futures can overcome the 130.88 objective...further gains are possible to another wave objective near 131.24," Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said in a research note.
To the downside, they said an uptrend at 130.06 was an important test for the short-term.
"A breach signals retracement toward 129.74 and possibly a more extensive retracement phase toward the important 129.54 area," they said.
September Pibor futures were at 96.55, up two basis points on the day.
